title: 第6章 主角模板！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
面对抵住自己咽喉的木剑。

    厉行天果断怂了，反正上一世在宗门也没少认怂，双手高高举起手道：

    “我不是，我不认识你说的那些人。”

    李应灵目光一凝，冷声道：“那你来这做什么？”

    厉行天思绪飞快，正想着找什么借口搪塞。

    庙宇方向就有一道声音幽幽传来。

    “肯定是我们门派已经声名远播，这位青年才俊肯定是来加入我们宗门的吧？”

    厉行天侧目望去，发现一位穿着破旧道袍的俊秀年轻人倚靠在门边，一脸笑意的看着自己。

    李应灵有些无语道：“师父，我觉得……是不是不太可能？”

    自家所谓的宗门什么德行，李应灵还是不懂的话，那就是纯傻子了。

    师父修为或许不错，但估计也不能横推玄武国，只是身份存疑，不知道哪里来的那么多顶尖功法。

    但要说闻名在外，让人来投，纯粹是夜谈周公——说梦话。

    楚星尘则是慢慢悠悠的走了过来。

    目光仔细打量着面前的年轻人。

    短发，略显干瘦，明明喉咙被剑指着却也眼神却毫不慌张。

    看了一眼系统。

    【目标：厉行天】

    【修为：炼气二层】

    【金色词条：重生者】

    【紫色词条：杀伐果断】

    【蓝色词条：重情重义】

    【满足收徒条件】

    刚刚系统有提示，附近出现了一个满足收徒条件的人出现。

    神识一扫，就发现这人被李应灵逮到了。

    楚星尘看着面前的少年啧啧称奇。

    好家伙重生者，这一看就是主角模版呐。

    尤其是重情重义这个选项，一看就是掌门的小棉袄啊，只可惜是男的。

    难得有送上门的弟子，怎么说也要纳入麾下。

    厉行天看着楚星尘一脸看透自己的摸样不由有些心惊。

    没想到来的不是护道人，而是她师父亲自来了。

    厉行天深吸一口气，缓缓询问道：“敢问这位前辈宗门？”

    听到这个问题，李应灵也是满眼好奇的望向楚星尘。

    因为她也不知道，每次李应灵问的时候，师父总会糊弄过去也不回答。

    其实这个问题不单单困扰李应灵许久。

    也困扰了楚星尘许久，作为起名困难症患者，他其实一直也很想起有内涵又文雅的名字。
content_en:
Faced with the wooden sword pressed against his throat.

Li Xingtian resolutely gave in. Anyway, he had given in in the sect in his previous life. He raised his hands high and said:

"I'm not, I don't know the people you're talking about."

Li Yingling's eyes narrowed and she said coldly: "Then what are you doing here?"

Li Xingtian's thoughts were racing rapidly, and he was thinking of some excuse to make excuses.

There was a faint voice coming from the direction of the temple.

"Our sect must have become famous. This young talent must have come to join our sect, right?"

Li Xingtian looked sideways and found a handsome young man wearing shabby robes leaning against the door, looking at him with a smile on his face.

Li Yingling was speechless and said: "Master, I think... is it impossible?"

If Li Yingling still doesn't understand the so-called virtues of his sect, then he is a complete fool.

The master's cultivation may be good, but he probably can't overtake the Xuanwu Kingdom. It's just that his identity is questionable, and he doesn't know where he got so many top skills.

But to say that he is famous outside and that people come to vote for him is just talking about Duke Zhou at night - talking in his sleep.

Chu Xingchen walked over slowly.

He looked carefully at the young man in front of him.

He has short hair and is slightly skinny. He has a sword pointed at his throat but his eyes are not panicked.

Glanced at the system.

[Target: Li Xingtian]

[Cultivation: Second level of Qi refining]

[Golden Entry: Reborn]

[Purple entry: decisive killing]

[Blue entry: Emphasis on love and meaning]

【Meet the conditions for accepting apprentices】

The system just prompted a message that a person who meets the conditions for accepting a disciple appeared nearby.

With a quick glance of his consciousness, he discovered that this man had been caught by Li Yingling.

Chu Xingchen looked at the young man in front of him and marveled.

Good guy Reborn, this looks like the template for the protagonist.

Especially the option of attaching importance to love and justice. At first glance, it looks like the little cotton-padded jacket of the leader, but it's a pity that he is a man.

It is rare to have a disciple come to your door, no matter what, you must take him under his command.

Li Xingtian couldn't help but feel a little frightened when he saw Chu Xingchen's expression on his face.

Unexpectedly, it was not the guardian who came, but her master himself.

Li Xingtian took a deep breath and asked slowly: "Dare you ask this senior sect?"

Hearing this question, Li Yingling also looked at Chu Xingchen with curiosity.

Because she didn't know that every time Li Yingling asked, the master would always fool him and not answer.

In fact, this problem has not only troubled Li Yingling for a long time.

It has also troubled Chu Xingchen for a long time. As a patient with naming difficulties, he has always wanted to think of meaningful and elegant names.
